reviewed_by: Implementing agent; exact recovery selection reviewed against the scoped diff
reason: The change releases only paired orphan claims for failed provider turns after durable tool, hook, child and approval checks. Three exact recovery regressions cover preserved failed-turn history, unsafe effects, and mismatched goal claims; collection found 14 cases across SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: Only the three named tests in test_runtime_orphan_recovery.py are selected. The rest of that module, all other Python suites, frontend/browser/native tests, production Core access, and live provider or Mac operations are excluded. PostgreSQL tests ran against a disposable localhost-only PostgreSQL 16 container with tmpfs storage; no persistent database was used.
